t2.title: Social media had a positive or negative impact on society
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Has social media had a positive or negative impact on society?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Social media has transformed how we communicate. I believe it has both positive and negative impacts, though the negatives are increasingly concerning.

Firstly, social media enables instant communication across distances. Families stay connected, and people maintain friendships effortlessly. It also gives voice to social movements and spreads awareness about important issues.

Secondly, platforms provide business opportunities. Small businesses reach customers globally, and individuals build careers as content creators. The economic impact has been substantial.

However, social media harms mental health. Studies link heavy usage to anxiety, depression, and loneliness. Cyberbullying has become a serious problem, particularly among young people.

Furthermore, misinformation spreads rapidly on these platforms. Fake news influences elections and public health decisions, creating dangerous societal divisions.

In conclusion, social media is a powerful tool requiring responsible use. Users should limit screen time and verify information, while platforms must improve content moderation.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
Social media is... um... good? I like Facebook. I see my friends. It is fun. But... sometimes it is bad. I don't know. Bye!
t2.sampleA2: Hello. I think social media is good and bad. It is good because I can talk to my friends. I can see their photos. But it is bad because sometimes people are mean. And I spend too much time on my phone. It is okay, but not always good. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
In my opinion, social media has both good and bad effects on society. On the one hand, it's great because you can easily connect with people all over the world. For example, I can talk to my cousins in Canada every day. Also, it’s a good way to find information and news.

However, there are also some negative aspects. I think people spend too much time online and not enough time in the real world. Also, there can be a lot of fake news and cyberbullying. So, it's important to be careful and not believe everything you see online. Overall, I think it's a mixed bag.
t2.sampleB2:
Great topic — this one always sparks a good debate, so here's my take.

Honestly, I reckon social media is a double-edged sword. On the plus side, it's completely changed the way we stay in touch. I can catch up with friends abroad in seconds, and small businesses can now reach customers they'd never have found otherwise. It's also given ordinary people a platform to speak up about the things that matter to them.

That said, there's a flip side. Endless scrolling eats up hours of my day, and constantly comparing yourself to picture-perfect posts can really chip away at your confidence. Worse still, fake news spreads like wildfire, and it's getting harder to tell fact from fiction.

At the end of the day, I don't think social media is good or bad in itself — it all comes down to how we use it. If we set a few boundaries and think before we post, the good can easily outweigh the bad.

What about the rest of you? Has it done more harm than good in your experience? I'd love to hear your thoughts!
t2.uzSample:
Ijtimoiy media bizning muloqot qilish usulimizni o'zgartirdi. Menimcha, uning ijobiy va salbiy ta'sirlari bor, garchi salbiy tomonlari tobora tashvishli bo'lsa ham.

Birinchidan, ijtimoiy media masofalar bo'ylab tezkor aloqani ta'minlaydi. Oilalar aloqada bo'lib turadi va odamlar do'stlikni bemalol saqlab qolishadi. Shuningdek, u ijtimoiy harakatlarga ovoz beradi va muhim masalalar haqida xabardorlikni oshiradi.

Ikkinchidan, platformalar biznes imkoniyatlarini taqdim etadi. Kichik bizneslar butun dunyo bo'ylab mijozlarga yetib boradi va shaxslar kontent yaratuvchilari sifatida martaba qurishadi. Iqtisodiy ta'siri sezilarli bo'ldi.

Biroq, ijtimoiy media ruhiy salomatlikka zarar yetkazadi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, undan haddan tashqari foydalanish xavotir, depressiya va yolg'izlik bilan bog'liq. Kiberbulling jiddiy muammoga aylandi, ayniqsa yoshlar orasida.

Bundan tashqari, noto'g'ri ma'lumotlar ushbu platformalarda tez tarqaladi. Soxta yangiliklar saylovlar va jamoat salomatligi qarorlariga ta'sir o'tkazib, xavfli ijtimoiy bo'linishlarni yaratadi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ijtimoiy media - bu mas'uliyatli foydalanishni talab qiladigan kuchli vosita. Foydalanuvchilar ekran vaqtini cheklashi va ma'lumotlarni tekshirishi kerak, platformalar esa kontentni moderatsiyalashni yaxshilashi zarur.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar... hmm... yaxshi? Menga Facebook yoqadi. Men do'stlarimni ko'raman. Bu qiziqarli. Lekin... ba'zida yomon. Bilmayman. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2: Salom. Menimcha, ijtimoiy media yaxshi ham, yomon ham. U yaxshi, chunki men do'stlarim bilan gaplasha olaman. Men ularning rasmlarini ko'ra olaman. Lekin u yomon, chunki ba'zida odamlar yomon bo'lishadi. Va men telefonimda juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazaman. Bu yaxshi, lekin har doim ham yaxshi emas. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Mening fikrimcha, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning jamiyatga ham yaxshi, ham yomon ta'siri bor. Bir tomondan, bu juda yaxshi, chunki siz butun dunyo bo'ylab odamlar bilan osongina bog'lanishingiz mumkin. Misol uchun, men har kuni Kanadadagi amakivachchalarim bilan gaplasha olaman. Bundan tashqari, bu ma'lumot va yangiliklarni topishning yaxshi usuli.

Biroq, ba'zi salbiy jihatlari ham bor. O'ylaymanki, odamlar internetda juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazadilar va real hayotda yetarli vaqt o'tkazmaydilar. Bundan tashqari, ko'plab soxta yangiliklar va kiberbulling bo'lishi mumkin. Shunday qilib, ehtiyot bo'lish va internetda ko'rgan hamma narsaga ishonmaslik muhim. Umuman olganda, menimcha, bu aralash holat.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning jamiyatga ta'siri murakkab masala bo'lib, uning inkor etib bo'lmaydigan foydalari ham, sezilarli kamchiliklari ham bor. U aloqa va axborot almashinuvida inqilob qilsa-da, uning salbiy oqibatlari tobora yaqqol namoyon bo'lmoqda.

Ijobiy jihatlardan biri - bu ta'minlaydigan aloqa imkoniyatlarining kengayganidir. Odamlar geografik chegaralar bo'ylab munosabatlarni saqlab qolishlari mumkin, chekka hududlardagi jamoalar esa qo'llab-quvvatlash va tarmoqlar qurish imkoniyatiga ega. Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy media platformalari ijtimoiy faollik va muhim masalalarni yoritish uchun kuchli vositaga aylandi.

Biroq, kamchiliklari ham anchagina. Doimiy ravishda saralangan kontentga duchor bo'lish yetishmovchilik va xavotir hislariga olib kelishi mumkin. Kiberbulling va onlayn ta'qiblar, ayniqsa, yoshlar orasida keng tarqalgan muammolardir. Bundan tashqari, noto'g'ri ma'lumot va tashviqotning tez tarqalishi demokratik jarayonlar va jamoat salomatligiga jiddiy tahdid soladi. Ijtimoiy media kompaniyalari kontentni yanada samarali moderatsiya qilish va foydalanuvchilarni o'qitish orqali ushbu muammolarni hal qilishlari kerak. Yakuniy xulosa shuki, ijtimoiy medianing foydali tomonlaridan foydalanish va uning zararli ta'sirini kamaytirish uchun muvozanatli yondashuv zarur.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who needs professional photos for a job application. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I heard you need professional photos for your application. I recently went to SnapShine and they were brilliant! The photographer made me feel so relaxed and the photos turned out amazing. You should definitely book a session – they're really affordable too! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Nodirbek,
I go photo studio. Good!
You need photo? Go!
Bye!
t11.sampleA2:

I went to a photo studio. It was good and the photos are nice. You need photos for your job, right? I think you should go there because it is easy. The people are nice too. See you!

t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom Nodirbek,

Eshitishimcha, sizga ishga kirish uchun fotosuratlar kerak ekan. Yaqinda SnapShine degan yangi studioga bordim va menimcha, u juda yaxshi edi. Fotografi do'stona edi va studiyada yaxshi uskunalar bor edi. O'ylaymanki, siz u yerga borishni o'ylab ko'rishingiz kerak.

Sening ishga ariza topshirayotganingni eshitib juda xursand bo'ldim! Professional fotosuratlarga bo'lgan ehtiyojni ham tushunaman. Men yaqinda SnapShine deb nomlangan yangi studiyada suratga tushdim va darhol seni o'yladim.

Rostini aytsam, men juda ta'sirlandim. Fotosuratchi meni qanday pozaga solishni juda yaxshi bilardi va studiyaning muhiti ajoyib edi. O'ylaymanki, ularni tekshirib ko'rishga arziydi. Ularning narxlari juda raqobatbardosh va yakuniy mahsulot juda yaxshi edi. Ishonchim komilki, ajoyib fotosurating intervyuga kirish imkoniyatingni sezilarli darajada oshiradi.

Arizang bilan omad!

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Malika Tojiyeva

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the photography studio. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear SnapShine Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your photography studio. I was extremely pleased with the session. Your photographer was incredibly professional and knew exactly how to capture my best angles. The studio setup was impressive, and the photo editing enhanced the images beautifully. However, I have some suggestions. The delivery time for edited photos was rather slow – two weeks is quite long. Additionally, the online gallery interface was slightly confusing to navigate. I would appreciate express editing options for urgent needs. Family packages with discounts for groups would attract more customers. Also, offering video content creation would meet modern social media needs. Overall, I am delighted with my photographs. Yours sincerely, Malika Tojiyeva
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SnapShine,


Photos good. Studio ok. I like photos. Thank you.


Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SnapShine Team,


Thank you for the photos. I like the photos and the photographer was nice. The studio was good too, but it was a little cold. I think you should make it warmer. And the photos took a long time. Maybe you can be faster next time. I liked it but it could be better.


Thank you,
Malika Tojiyeva
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SnapShine Team,


Thank you for the email. I wanted to tell you about my experience at your studio.


I thought the photographer was very good and the studio was nice. I was happy with the photos, but I think the editing took too long. I waited a long time to get them.


In my opinion, you should offer faster editing for people who need the photos quickly. Also, maybe you could have more options for different photo sizes. I would also like to see more background choices in the studio. Overall, I had a good experience.


Sincerely,
Malika Tojiyeva
t12.sampleB2:
Dear SnapShine Team,

Thank you for reaching out about my recent photo session. I'm glad to share my thoughts.

On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. Your photographer was friendly and professional, and put me at ease right away, which really brought out my best angles. The studio was spotless and well equipped, and I was delighted with the final edits — natural, yet polished.

That said, I have a few suggestions. The editing took around two weeks, so a faster turnaround option would be a real bonus for clients on tight deadlines. I'd also love to see discounted family packages, as I'm sure they would go down well. Finally, offering short video clips alongside the photos would appeal to social media users.

Thank you once again for a wonderful experience.

Yours sincerely,
Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli SnapShine jamoasi,

Sizning fotosur'at studiyangizdagi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Sessiyadan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Sizning fotograflaringiz nihoyatda professional edi va mening eng yaxshi rakurslarimni qanday suratga olishni juda yaxshi bilardi. Studiya jihozlari hayratlanarli edi va fotosuratlarni tahrirlash rasmlarni juda chiroyli qilib yaxshiladi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Tahrirlangan fotosuratlarni yetkazib berish vaqti ancha sekin edi – ikki hafta juda uzoq. Bundan tashqari, onlayn galereya interfeysi biroz chalkash edi.

Agar zarur bo'lsa, tezkor tahrirlash imkoniyatlarini taqdim etishingizni xohlardim. Guruhlar uchun chegirmalar bilan oilaviy paketlar ko'proq mijozlarni jalb qiladi. Shuningdek, video kontent yaratishni taklif qilish zamonaviy ijtimoiy media ehtiyojlarini qondiradi.

Umuman olganda, men o'z fotosuratlarimdan juda xursandman.

Hurmat bilan, Malika Tojiyeva
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom SnapShine,


Suratlar yaxshi. Studiya yaxshi. Menga suratlar yoqadi. Rahmat.


Xayr
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli SnapShine jamoasi,


Suratlar uchun rahmat. Menga suratlar yoqdi va fotograf yaxshi edi. Studiya ham yaxshi edi, lekin biroz sovuq edi. O'ylaymanki, siz uni iliqroq qilishingiz kerak. Va suratlar juda ko'p vaqt oldi. Ehtimol, keyingi safar tezroq bo'lishingiz mumkin. Menga yoqdi, lekin yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi.


Rahmat,
Malika Tojiyeva
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SnapShine jamoasi,


Elektron pochta xabaringiz uchun rahmat. Sizga studiyangizdagi tajribam haqida aytib bermoqchiman.


Menimcha, fotograf juda yaxshi edi va studiya ham yoqimli. Fotosuratlardan xursand bo'ldim, lekin tahrirlash juda uzoq davom etdi deb o'ylayman. Ularni olish uchun uzoq vaqt kutdim.


Mening fikrimcha, siz fotosuratlarni tezda olishi kerak bo'lgan odamlar uchun tezroq tahrirlashni taklif qilishingiz kerak. Shuningdek, turli xil fotosurat o'lchamlari uchun ko'proq variantlarga ega bo'lishingiz mumkin. Studiyada ko'proq fon tanlovlarini ko'rishni ham xohlardim. Umuman olganda, yaxshi tajribaga ega bo'ldim.


Hurmat bilan,
Malika Tojiyeva
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SnapShine jamoasi,


Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan fotosessiyam yuzasidan bildirilgan e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat. Tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozmoqdaman.


Umuman olganda, fotosuratlarning sifati va fotograflarning professionalligi meni juda mamnun qildi. Studiya sharoitlari yetarli edi, ammo kutish xonasi biroz yaxshilanishi mumkin, masalan, qulayroq o'rindiqlar qo'yish mumkin.


Biroq, bir nechta takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, tahrirlangan fotosuratlarni olish muddati kutilganidan uzoqroq bo'ldi. Ushbu jarayonni soddalashtirish foydali bo'ladi. Ikkinchidan, turli o'lcham va pardozdagi nashrlarni taklif qilish afzalroq bo'lar edi. Nihoyat, turli xil mijozlarning xohishlariga mos keladigan tematik fotosessiya paketlarini joriy etishni ko'rib chiqing; masalan, vintage yoki kinematografik mavzular ko'proq mijozlarni jalb qilishi mumkin.


Umuman olganda, ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldim va yana sizning xizmatlaringizdan foydalanishni o'ylab ko'raman.


Hurmat bilan,
Malika Tojiyeva
